summary: Backend-only regression run for The Kitchen Atelier MVP. Authored /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covering auth (register/login/me), products CRUD + role gating, product image upload/proxy, orders (validation, unavailable rejection, bad variation, KA-XXXXXX numbering, idempotent client_ref, customer isolation, cross-customer 403), admin status update (creates history + customer notification), admin notes update, dashboard summary (admin only), customers listing (admin only), notifications list+mark read, settings get/put + admin gating, and 9-status list. All 33 tests passed (100%). Full-stack seed data (admin, demo customer, 5 demo products, settings) is present and idempotent. No expo/react native issues assessed (frontend testing was skipped per request).

minor.issue: Zero-quantity payload is rejected at the Pydantic layer (422) because OrderItemIn uses Field(ge=1). The explicit `quantity must be positive` (HTTP 400) branch in _validate_and_build_items is unreachable. Not a functional bug; keeping test tolerant to both 400/422.

action_items: No backend fixes required. Optional: tighten OrderItemIn error to return 400 with a friendlier message instead of 422, or remove the unreachable branch.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~920 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth, products, orders, notifications, settings, storage) when it grows past 1k lines.
MongoDB ObjectId is correctly excluded via _*_dto helpers — no ObjectId leaks in responses.
Emergent Object Storage integration handles stale storage_key with a 503 retry; good.
Idempotency on POST /api/orders uses a unique sparse index on client_ref + application-level check — correctly returns the existing order.
Admin gating (require_admin) applied consistently to product mutations, order status/notes, dashboard, customers, and settings PUT.
Order isolation for customers is enforced in both list_orders (query filter) and get_order (customer_id equality check → 403).
seed_data_creation: Two ephemeral TEST_ customers were registered during the run (used for register + isolation tests). Several TEST_ products/orders were created and cleaned up where possible. Test-created orders remain in DB for auditability (order_number auto-increments).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Base URL comes from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Tests use pytest-xdist (parallel). Fresh customer B is registered per session to validate order isolation. If DB is wiped, backend startup re-seeds admin, demo customer, settings, and 5 demo products, so the suite is safe to re-run. Frontend tests were intentionally skipped per review_request (backend only).
